title: Krylov Complexity in Non-Inertial Quantum Systems
summary: This study formulates observer-dependent Krylov spreading for non-inertial quantum systems driven by linear Bogoliubov transformations. Starting with the closed single Rindler-pair $SU(1,1)$ sector, we show that its Lanczos basis is identical to the Rindler pair-number basis. As a result, the Krylov spread complexity reduces exactly to the mean number of correlated Rindler pairs, $C_k=\vertβ_k\vert^2$.
